description:
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {4}{B}.
Witch-Maw Nephilim's first ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Lab Rats, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Rat, adding {C}{C}.
When the Rat dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
